confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Siem Reap tourist price levels, projected to July 2026; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Beer, coffee and meal anchors are moderately confident; accommodation anchors are least certain because online rates vary widely by season and booking channel. Cocktail and wine anchors use the local draft-beer relationship as the basis because direct knowledge is weaker.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used as a direct benchmark. The basis is general Southeast Asian tourist-town pricing, informed by Siem Reap's tourist districts and similar Mekong-region destinations. Cocktail and wine anchors are scaled from the draft-beer anchor.
